mentions.name: Meetday
mentions.description: This app is a calendar-based group meeting tool: a group of friends creates a shared calendar and shareable link, coordinates in a built-in chat, and votes on a day and time to meet. It features a brutalist web design and requires no registration.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just vibe coded a calendar based group meeting app. A group of friends create a calendar and share the link, can coordinate in the chat, and in a calendar choose the day and time to meet. Everybody votes and that's it. All this in a nice brutalist web design. And no registering needed.
